**One source of truth.** Freshness is read from `v_ace_batch_status` only and never inferred from `data_as_of`, a row count or a file (BR9; FSD P1 A2.14.3 BR-P1-014-2). The Workbench writes no ACE data and holds product codes, source codes and times only.

**Wave 1 integration.** Wave 1 asserts JOB-02 (P3) and JOB-04 (P1); the start of JOB-07 and JOB-08 (rwb-payment, P8, wave 2) is verified in RWB-ITG-W2. The released case list is read from P1's `case_list_row` projection, not from a copy in the data lake (DP-17).

edits.old: - **In-process calls become events and a contract:** `AceDataReady` and `AceDataLate` are published as `rwb.source-data.AceDataReady.v1` and `rwb.source-data.AceDataLate.v1` on `rwb.source-data.events.v1` under a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope (DP-09); `FreshnessQuery` and `DailyCompletenessGate` are published interfaces of this service, reached over the contract, one hop and 2 s timeout (DP-11).
edits.new:
- **In-process calls become events and a contract:** `AceDataReady` and `AceDataLate` are published as `rwb.source-data.AceDataReady.v1` and `rwb.source-data.AceDataLate.v1` on `rwb.source-data.events.v1` under a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope (DP-09); `FreshnessQuery` and `DailyCompletenessGate` are published interfaces of this service, reached over the contract, one hop and 2 s timeout (DP-11).
- **Event envelope:** the CloudEvents attributes are `id`, `source`, `type`, `specversion`, `time`, `subject` (set to the source system) and `datacontenttype`; both events are keyed by `sourceSystem` and `businessDate`; the seven payload fields of TSD P1 T5.3 are typed in the AsyncAPI document; the registry subject is named by the platform event owner; the producing login is the rwb_source_data login (DP-02).

edits.old: 12. System: a later COMPLETED batch for the same business date sets status LOADED, records the new `loaded_at`, and starts the daily jobs through `AceDataReady`.
edits.new:
12. System: a later COMPLETED batch for the same business date sets status LOADED, records the new `loaded_at`, and starts the daily jobs through `AceDataReady`.

The bank scheduler contract has two paths: the ready and status operations for the scheduler, and the poll of the ACE batch record as the fallback. The path live at go-live is confirmed with the bank platform team before the integration test.
